name: Liquid Tabs
hint: Switch tabs. Watch the indicator stretch.
description: Segmented tabs whose indicator behaves like liquid: the leading edge springs ahead, the trailing edge lags, a droplet follows behind, and a goo filter fuses them.
usage: Use for 2–6 peer views: dashboard sections, settings panes, pricing period switches, filter modes. Keep labels to one word. Pass `tabs` (labels, or { id, label, icon, disabled, badge }) and own the selection with `value` + `onChange(index, label, id)`, or seed it with `defaultValue`. For real tabs, give each tab a `content` node or pass `renderPanel`, and the component renders the tabpanel; to render panels yourself, pass `panelId` (a function (index, tab) => id, or `panelId` on each tab), give each panel role="tabpanel", that id and aria-labelledby="<id>-tab", and set `showContent={false}`. Colours follow the theme; `accent` overrides the pill. `align="start"` stops it centring itself; `align="stretch"` fills the width with equal tabs.

keyboard.does: Moves focus to the selected tab, skipping the others; Tab again moves to the panel.
Moves to the previous or next enabled tab and selects it, wrapping at the ends; disabled tabs are skipped.
Moves to the first or last enabled tab and selects it.

screenReader: A tablist named by `ariaLabel` ("Sections" by default); each tab says its label and whether it is selected, and disabled tabs are aria-disabled. The panel is a tabpanel named by its tab, and is itself a Tab stop.

dataProps.type: Array<string | { id?: string | number; label?: node; icon?: string | node; disabled?: boolean; badge?: node; panelId?: string; content?: node }>
dataProps.description: The tabs: plain labels, or { id, label, icon?, disabled?, badge?, panelId?, content? }. icon is an icon name or a node; badge is a short count or node; content is that tab's panel. Empty renders nothing.
Controlled selection: the selected tab's id (or its index). Pass with onChange.
Uncontrolled starting tab: an id or index. Defaults to the first enabled tab.

dataProps.type: (index: number, label: node, id: string | number) => void
dataProps.description: (index, label, id) => void when the user picks another tab (click, arrows, Home/End).
Render the tabpanel under the tabs when there is panel content (renderPanel, a tab's content, or demo). false gives the tab bar alone.

dataProps.type: (label: node, index: number, tab: { id?: string | number; label?: node; icon?: string | node; disabled?: boolean; badge?: node; panelId?: string; content?: node }) => node
dataProps.description: (label, index, tab) => node: the panel for the selected tab. The component wraps it in role="tabpanel".

dataProps.type: string | ((index: number, tab: { id?: string | number; label?: node; icon?: string | node; disabled?: boolean; badge?: node; panelId?: string; content?: node }) => string)
dataProps.description: Panels you render yourself: (index, tab) => id of that tab's panel (the tab's own id is that + "-tab"), or one id string for a single panel you swap. A tab's own panelId wins.
true disables every tab; an array of indexes, ids or labels disables those. Disabled tabs are aria-disabled and skipped by the arrow keys.
Accessible name of the tab list.
Colour of the selected label. Defaults to --ts-accent-ink with the theme accent, and white with a custom accent.
"center" | "start" | "end" | "stretch": where the bar and panel sit in the component's box. "stretch" fills the width and gives every tab the same width.
Any other attribute (id, aria-*, data-*) goes to the root <div>. className and style are merged with the component's own.
